_meta.source: Manual classification pass over svitlanka's 88 editorial comments (rater axis 2, batch c1f109ec), 2026-08-18.
_meta.rules: fact_error = comment asserts a claim in the question/answer is factually wrong or a myth. logic_flaw = the question is logically incoherent. stale = the underlying datum is outdated or a moving estimate. duplicate = repeats a fact/topic already used in the batch (design artifact of D21 — arms shared facts/topics, published without dedupe). Minor wording imprecision (q02, q08, q56) is NOT flagged — svitlanka herself scored those 6-9.
_meta.hard_errors_cross_check: The 7 hard errors listed in issue-164 § Os 2 are exactly: q24, q27, q33, q35, q46, q52, q68. All flagged below.
_meta.note_on_issue_164_dup_count: issue-164 says all 16 of svitlanka's 1.0 scores were duplicates; in fact 3 of the 1.0s are not duplicates (q14 too niche/abstract, q24 logic nonsense, q35 myth).
